mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 38 degrees and foggy by the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waxing Gibbous moon. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is moving forward with plans to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population, while road reconstruction continues on Mark Drive and Legion Street.
There is a busy schedule of events ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run, followed by more music at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow and at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today is the perfect day for some Really Reese's, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
